items.text: It's a huge week next week, as we release 3 updates to Trash Goblin - a free tool for the base game, a paid DLC story expansion, and a cosmetic pack!
Of course we'll update you with all the details when we launch next week - May 7th for both the 1.5 update and the DLCs! - but for now take a look at the trailers, and read on for a little bit more!

The biggest thing about Maker's Fortune is that we've built in a brand new tool that expands the game from the first few hours all the way through to however long you want to play! "Recolouring" was something we had on our list of ideas from the very first day of development back in 2022(!?) so it feels great to be able to bring it to life for you now.

notes.title: PAID DLC EXPANSION "THE ARTIST OF BRIMHAVEN"

items.text: The Artist of Brimhaven DLC is a little bit of an experiment, and also a lovely 'what happened next...' piece of story content. We're just not sure what sort of DLC would delight the most players, so we started by thinking about the most popular characters and giving them more time to shine, plus offering a gameplay experience that takes what you know about Trash goblin and expands on it in an unexpected way - by letting you visit a District and then rebuild it!
We can't wait to see what you think when this releases on May 7th, and we'll be all ears when it comes to planning whatever DLC 2 might end up being.
Now then. We hit a bit of a milestone this week too!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44616587/c5d80952029bde4cd49ae3b8437bb0bf6b23f48e.png"]

Yup, quite the big number! We can't believe how far our little goblin game has gone, and really this is just the beginning! The whole team here can't thank you enough for all the love and support you've shown us, and we can't wait to see what the future holds 🥰🥰🥰
I'll just leave this here...
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44616587/07556c8d9d4c416b8c7f05cef4a22354d1342336.png"]
That's it for now, watch out for next week as we detail everything in all of these huge updates, all happening on Thursday May 7th!

Some existing players will experience a bit of an annoying issue with the new Geronimus quest. New players and players in the mid point of the game likely won't see this issue. There's potential that this will also happen on the Hortensius quest too. We can't retroactively fix this on peoples' save files sadly, and our apologies for that!

items.text: This mini patch is for the release of the Goblin Plushie DLC but includes a handful of small fixes:
The reference to the Heart Pendant had broken in the trinket pack in which it is unlocked. You should now start to see this trinket come through in your sack!
By popular request you can now put hats on top of the Dog and Bear Plushie's heads.
We've implemented a proper loading screen for when travelling to districts.
We've added a short "once upon a time" story beat on starting a new game.
2026 is an exiting one for us at Spilt Milk studios, and while we've got huge plans to share with you soon, we can't resist fixing some horrid bugs and bringing you the gosh darn cutest thing ever!

That's right, we're kicking off our official merchandise with a Goblin Plush! There's a link to our upcoming merch store in the game (it's on the main menu) so make sure to boot up, then go & register your interest - it's not long till the Kickstarter campaign goes live and you want to make sure you're first in line!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44616587/ad935b9149f5195208e49b04c0821efc6fde83c9.png"]
I actually just can't. So cute.

And yup, the game has been updated. We saw a huge flood of new goblins coming to play our game over the Winter Sale - welcome one and all - and that meant a few nasty bugs got surfaced, which we're delighted to announce have been squashed already!
We've fixed an issue that was causing some players to see a black screen when travelling to districts, or a missing cart when loading saves already at districts 🫏
Trinket icons will no longer behave erratically in the Stash when using a gamepad 🎮
The Candle Holder now connects to trays rather than bottles and cups!🕯️

We've removed the duplicate Harvest Festival cosmetic set from the customer mat and also corrected the order of the categories. This means there's a chance that currently equipped mat may change to the pattern immediately below it in the list, you'll just need to reselect your old one from the customisation interface 😅
The customisation interface for the Shop Sign now shows the correct name rather than displaying the variable name 🪧
Welcome to the final update of 2025, the Year of the Goblin! Or maybe 2026 will be that, if we can petition Steam to add Goblin as a tag, and to let us run a Goblin Sale Event...!?

As the year wraps up its been amazing to look back on everything we've achieved. 12 months ago(ish) we were in Early Access, had barely 25% of the game's current content, and so many exciting moments were still to come. It's been an incredible ride, and we can't wait to show you what we're cooking up for next year!
But before we get to the update's content, let's have some fun!
As we can't all get together and have fun irl, we thought it'd be cute to let you loose on a silly quiz - Which Trash Goblin Character Are You? We'd love to know who you are in the comments!

We're also ramping up our efforts towards the merchandise kickstarter that we're launching in January - you can register your interest there or via the button ingame - and of course tell your friends! We've already shown off one of the sticker sheets, so get excited to see more (pins, tshirts, mugs, etc!) soon!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44616587/21cc02a784b33467d020f6cf1eb1d5f6342726c8.png"]

We took the opportunity to rework the wallpaper system a little bit. Frankly, some of the sections of wall were very fiddly to customise, and that's if you had even spotted them in the first place, so we merged a few meshes to give you fewer overall wall pieces. It is now much easier and way more user-friendly for you to manifest your desired aesthetic!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44616587/7e8e913cb57a9cf33d3b6712c8a6c76ae2fc8f5e.jpg"]

For some players this change might have disrupted your chosen basement couture, so please do check and make sure you've got everything sorted. That's part of the reason why the wallpapers in this update's cosmetic set are free. To make it up to those of you who are just utterly distraught at the way we simply waltzed into your shop and changed things willy nilly. How very dare we!
This was intended as a smaller update but... it's Christmas so in the spirit of stuffing (birds, stockings, your face at the dinner table) we crammed as much in as we possibly could!
You can now view the full details of a dismissed customer's trinket request by hovering over it on the Quest Tracker. This much-requested feature is finally here to make your life so much easier!
NPCs were still sometimes asking you to break down your upcycled creations from the Display Mat! We're confident we have now put a stop to this cheekiness once and for all.
A bunch of existing trinkets have had new sockets added and one or two have had their socket types tweaked, all the better for more crazy upcycled monstrosi- I mean works of art.

Donoval will no longer just stand at your window and refuse to speak to you if you quit the game during the middle of a conversation with him. Though in future, you probably shouldn't be so rude to the Best Lizard Ever!
The wooden board at the back of the bed pipe can now be customised with simple colours, just like the shelves. Get painting!
The game now remembers the last chisel you used when reloading save files. Clever game.
The Return To Shop button now has a confirmation pop-up. Because we've all misclicked and lost out on a queue of eager customers...

Based on player feedback we've adjusted the timing of the "Success For Donoval" questline so that there are fewer days between his appearances. this will be readjusted when we next introduce more quests to the endgame.
We fixed a rare bug which reverted tool upgrades back to the default when connection to the Steam client dropped while you were loading a save.

We've added a set of goal-type quests to help guide new players towards useful purchases from Expansion Mode, including the Soak Tub and the Display Mat - things we think all players will get a kick out of, and that help to reveal the full potential of the game.
The Game Guide now has a section describing how the Reputation system works.
The 1.3 quests have been updated so that customers will now state when they want their trinkets clean.
Nomia will once again disappear when dismissed during their "customer dismissal" tutorial.
The Goblin Geode Idol will no longer levitate on shelves.
A bunch of other trinkets have also had their box collider adjusted so they sit on surfaces better.
"Quilted Bedding" versions of the reputation cosmetics now unlock at the correct level.
We've fixed some text overflow issues on a bunch of interfaces and buttons across multiple languages; thanks to all of you who helped us spot these!
The game will no longer freeze if your connection to Steam drops whilst chipping, upcycling or cleaning.
Text shadowing on the End of Day screen had gone missing. It is now back in place. Phew.
You will now be charged the correct amount when buying a full set of wallpaper patterns or shelves. Who can say what maths was being used before. Certainly not us.

Small Workmat and Large Workmat cosmetic overrides are no longer part of a set, and have to be purchased individually. This means you'll no longer be overcharged for a set when you own the Large Workmat.
The correct icon for the Spirit Culture bedpipe customisation is now in place.
The Goblin Geode Idol is now accepted by customers when they ask for Goblin Trinkets.

We've changed the orientation of connections on some charms (such as the Philospider's Stone Charm) so that when connected to necklaces via a "split ring" type trinket, they connect facing forward. Much better.
We've lowered the purchase price of the small shelves in Expansion Mode.
We've reduced the number of smoke particles on the stove for some performance wins on low end machines (including Steam Deck).
We've adjusted the lighting at various times of day to improve readability around the shop.
We've made some performance improvements to the lights in the workshop, and to the cart loading at markets.
The human paperdoll system has been optimised which should mean they load in quicker.
⛄A final note, we're obviously taking a break with everyone else for the Christmas period, so expect us to be pretty quiet here and in the forums until January 😴
There are now 11 new achievements to sink your teeth into, all related to the Success for Donoval update!
We've fixed an issue that was preventing Seliki from appearing on some saves.
When changing languages the options within drop down lists on the Options Menu will now instantly update to the new language.
Customer names and request summaries now pull through the correct localised text under the Current Customer section of the Quest Tracker.
Polish will now only be seen on the Day End screen when you have the language set to Polish!
We've fixed all the text wrapping and UI overflow issues on the Options Menu in all languages.
The Day counter on the HUD now updates instantly when changing languages in game.
The Day counter will no longer overlap with the Gold counter when it wraps onto 2 lines

The Carabiner and Safety Pin now have an extra connection which allows you to use them as jump rings for necklaces - this means charms with parallel loops (e.g. Silver Pocket Watch, Philospider's Stone Charm) can now face forward when attaching them to necklaces.
We've added a little padlock icon to the species cosmetics on the customisation interface to make it clearer that these patterns are locked until you max out the Reputation.
Welcome to the latest and greatest of our huge free updates for Trash Goblin! As of now, we're confident saying that we've doubled the size of the game compared to 1.0 launch!
First up - and this is huge - we've fully localised the entire game into 7 languages!
Localisation
Those of you who speak French, Italian, German, Spanish, Polish, Russian or Brazilian Portuguese can now enjoy the whole game properly!

We're delighted about this as it welcomes so many more goblins to the fold, and we can't wait to see what you think - thought do bear in mind we're a small team so if there are any issues please do report them as a bug on our discord and we'll do our best to fix them as soon as possible! With your help it'll be perfect!
Reputation System

This is something we've been brewing for a long time now. We know that the game is super chill, soothing and cosy. We don't want to mess with that. But the 'selling' portion of the game seemed a little lacking to us, and we wanted to see about adding something the drives an interesting decision or two without adding stress or any real risk/reward friction.

Instead of having to always take what you're offered for a trinket's sale, now when you're dealing with a "stranger" customer (ie: anyone not a named character) you'll be able to offer them one of two prices; the Market Price, or the Generous Price.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44616587/642f3461d5a7e8971e4e10ce7826e642640f9e51.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44616587/dfc53a3c8c07b85f55644ed090950a9f23d95171.png"]

The Market Price is fair, and the customer is always happy to pay it - you're not trying to squeeze them for profits after all 😅 And in the short term, going for the Market Price will help you save up for time-savers like the Soak Tub or game-changers like the Display Mat. You'll get a small amount of Reputation too, as you're always being fair with your prices.
Choosing the Generous Price will mean you get less gold in the short term, but more Reputation...
...so what is Reputation for?
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44616587/e0ab1116d99dffd82cba7a8454e13fdb30d6207a.png"]

Over the course of the game, you'll be levelling up your reputation for each species. Doing so means that in the future you'll see more customers of that species giving tips, and also those tips will get larger. Then once you've maxed out the Reputation for a given species, you'll unlock a cosmetic set themed around them (see below for pics!) as a celebration of their culture!
Named customers behave a little differently, as it made sense to have the reputation and sales prices be more determined by the emotional heft of the story beat.
You can never lose Reputation, and customers are always happy with your offer, so don't worry about which option you choose! It all depends on your goals.

When you load your saved game from 1.2 (or earlier), we've made sure to calculate roughly how much Reputation you will have gained so far, and award it to you immediately. That way you don't have to start again - unless you want to!
To keep track of your Reputation, we've added a new tab to the Stash Book
Any time you hit a new level, a popup card will announce it
You can get an idea of just how much Reputation a sale wins you by how many hearts are shown above the customer's head 💖💖💖💖💖💖
Success For Donoval!
How can we name an update like this, and not deliver on that promise?!
Well, this brand new type of quest is something we've added beyond the end of the game, so if you're wanting more game to play - this is for you!

Without spoiling too much, Donoval decides his skills as a travelling merchant could be put to good use in combination with your lil' goblin business, and he'll gladly take sacks full of up to 5 trinkets off on his next adventure.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44616587/5848ef9722b8a6f973ec5ea10f71ebda1ac3709f.png"]

On his return you'll get the profits, he'll take his share, and you get treated to a little glimpse into the wider world of Trash Goblin with his stories. This content is designed to be space out as Donoval goes for some very long journeys - think multiple in-game days - but once you 'complete' this new questline a... well let's just say there's an obvious candidate for him to hand over his entrepreneurial reigns to!

But it's also winter, so of course it's time for a seasonal cosmetic set too! The Wind Festival!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44616587/7219ed55dedc13c918115128cb33b120620dad56.png"]
Even More Quests!

We reckon this new set of quests - introducing a bunch of new characters and seeing the return of another - add up to about 2 hours of new content by themselves, and are sprinkled through the game in sensible spots according to the narrative. Combine that with Donoval's new content and we're easily past 3 more hours of Trash Goblin story to enjoy at your own pace!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44616587/93b3e8b69559abd62b16592f996caf528dc9f01c.png"]
More Customisation!

And we don't stop there, oh no. We've got an unlockable and customisable shop sign for you to hang outside your shop, plus you can now also customise the colour of your customer desk and your workbench to really enable your chosen aesthetic touch every element of your space!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44616587/655ab5bb48195ad46c352b087f340319d2d7ffec.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44616587/add5a01a61e68e8d5b194894f4006a7c1fcecdb2.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44616587/609366c64ec21e1840f0787747cc557d18905bd6.png"]

Bug Fixes and Other Updates

When customers look at objects on the Display Mat, they are no longer capable of asking for a sub-trinket of something upcycled. This was super annoying, so glad we fixed it! <- sorry, this isn't quite fixed yet!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44616587/b19faf1efefe04dac0690a7b5bf337f1a877c862.png"]Here we are, all done with 1.2 and doing amazing things in preparation for 1.3! We'll spill the beans on 1.3 in an upcoming post, we promise!

We're excited to be nominated in the DevGAMM Awards, and there's a community vote category, so we thought we'd be cheeky and ask a favour - if you’ve enjoyed Trash Goblin, we’d love it if you could show your support by voting for us here 💚

So that's it - we're really excited to have you enjoying the game on your Steam Decks, we're keeping an eye out for issues and whatnot in case we need to hotfix, and we're cracking on with all the hard work needed for 1.3 and beyond!

We've corrected the order of the Spirit and Sun Festival cosmetics so that Founder's Pack cosmetics are not swapped out for these new wall papers. Any changes to your decor will be reverted when next loading your save file.

Welcome to the first of our planned large updates for Trash Goblin! This update contains a ton of work from the team - some of it even from before the 1.0 launch - and we're really excited to see what you think of it!

We think this update adds at least 2 hours of extra gameplay to Trash Goblin, and way more if you chase the new achievements and all the entries for the new trinkets in your Trinketpedia. But more importantly, it introduces a whole new species of customer to the game! Read on for the full details...
What's New

The headline addition is the new species, the Spiritfolk! They're mysterious beings who don't exactly interact with the world in the same way others do. Their addition brings a whole raft of exciting new stuff, including:
A set of 10 themed trinkets, based on their culture
A new Named Customer! A Spirit of course, alongside their unique questline! Get to know this exciting addition to our cast of characters... and maybe even delve into your own past in the process...
New paperdolls! Spiritfolk will turn up as "stranger" customers after a certain point in the story.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44616587/1f4ec0f7725b341f758576e79ca68e3d051734c1.png"]
New District - Follybrink

This is a location in Silver City that is very popular with a certain kind of tourist, the ones who want to see the spicier areas of the Chasm. You know the ones. The type that Mycelle would not appreciate being in his tour groups.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44616587/d607fcd69582c8874ec8e27dfcb00bc9bb175f4b.png"]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44616587/57c1a1e233c51d2ab1b90d58efc123b94d7bffdc.png"]
It's a beautiful place, though a very different vibe to the other areas we've visited, and we can't wait to see what you think of it!
New (mini) Donoval Quest

We've heard people calling for a "Sequel for Donoval!" and while it's not that grand, we couldn't resist having that lovely lizard come back to see what new stock you've got. Expect more like this in future updates if it goes down well! Also, a few other familiar faces return as well, so keep an eye out.
Shop Shut Sign

We've been seeing plenty of you goblins asking for a way to stop customers coming - if only to reduce the pressure you feel to serve them - and so we have added a feature that lets you do just that! Once introduced to you by Aunty V, you can choose to either close the shop entirely which prevents all customers coming back, or setting it so that only customers you've asked to return will show up. Of course you'll have to make sure to open it up again once you're ready!

Closing your shop pauses the timers that govern when customers arrive so they don't stack up, but it doesn't pause time itself (that'd be a neat trick) so you still see the day turn to night, and actions still take up time slots. You're also free to travel to districts to sell at your pop-up events - though you cannot shut the popup, as the entire point of travelling there is to sell sell sell! So to be clear, it's only the main shop that has this functionality.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44616587/60e56077e9c2f36aa3564de4f222a5c86f35b10a.png"]

On your first playthrough this will unlock shortly after you first district trip, but for anyone beyond that point, Aunty knows and will show up soon enough. We hope you enjoy this newfound freedom in how to play!
Big Upcycling Improvement

We've added a feature where the game will add an icon to the screen edges for each of your viable trinkets around the workshop that are out of view during Upcycling. Clicking on this allows you to grab that trinket regardless of where it is located, meaning you can be a lot more free in your combinations! It also has a tooltip so you can check the name, plus it shows you which are already upcycled so you can make informed choices!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44616587/8658b6a2debc595d1cf4e591908d12d7c5ef37b2.png"]
Also featuring...
25 additional new trinkets (so that's 35 in total for this update!)
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44616587/51d74c0d20e9b1cccde05b2a8059157568c959d0.png"]
3 new cosmetic sets - Sun, Spirit and Ambassador!
7 new achievements

It's worth noting that most of this new content really comes into play after you've completed the main questline, so now's the perfect time to return to Silver City and see what's been going on since your last visit!
Bug Fixes and Other Updates
Achievements now fire retroactively (good for anyone coming over from the demo!).
You can now adjust the SFX level for chipping and cleaning separately.
Fixed a rare issue where a trinket could despawn as you moved from the work bench to the customer window.
Changed the Safety Pin's socket connection so that it now correctly acts as a "charm", like those that connect with necklaces.
We've adjusted necklace and hair pin connections so that charms don't start out at an angle that clips through the necklace.

The Lantern connection point on the Goblin Mask has been tweaked to the correct angle to prevent clipping (which also means you can now connect all "charm" type trinkets like the hairpin tassel, heart pendant, bead necklace charm, etc.
Tooltips now adjust positioning so they don't go off screen edges.
The Map view now has the intended audio treatment.
The Stone Frog's socket connections have been corrected.
Characters within the crowd will no longer shrink as they walk past your shop.

And there we have it, a humongous update for all you Goblins out there to get your mucky paws on! We'd be delighted to hear what you think, and we'll be lurking in the steam forums but we welcome you to our discord too, especially if you like sharing your upcycling creations and pics of your workshop!
Greetings Goblins! We've got another bug fix patch for you.

Don't worry folks, we've not forgotten about the new road map. Things are just super busy here at Spilt Milk HQ at the moment and also slightly disrupted - as well as working on all the exciting future plans, we're also prepping for the Develop next week. The whole team are heading down to Brighton to the Develop Awards as we're nominated for Best In-Game Accessibility and Best Small Studio. Plus our Audio Engineer, Ben, is up for the Game Dev Hero Audio award! Keep your little goblin fingers crossed for us!
Once we're back from Develop we'll be finalising a few things and then should have some exciting news to share with in the coming weeks.
We've fixed an issue that was causing some players to get stuck inside the upcycling ceremony and deleting trinkets.
NPCs will no longer refuse to accept the correct trinket after the game has saved with an unwanted trinket on the sales mat.
The Upclycing and Pay-What-You-Can information boxes can now be closed
Changes to the camera edge movement setting will no longer reset after reloading the game.
Icons for trinkets placed in the soak tub will no longer default to the bottle icon after reloading save files.
We've made some tweaks to prevent random NPCs from creating requests for non existent trinkets.
Trinkets can no longer be duplicated by manipulting full Stash books!
The Hz setting in the Resolution field on the Options menu will no longer default to your monitor's max refresh rate on reload.
Hello Goblins!

Welcome to our "mini upcycling update". We've got a handful of upcycling related bug fixes for you, plus we've been adding some new sockets to existing trinkets. Some of these changes are based on requests from the community and some are additions we wanted to make but haven't had the time until now. We've got plenty more of the tweaks planned but if you have some suggestions of your own, we'd love to hear them. Head over to our Discord and let us know what you've like to see. We can't promise we'll make every change - some things are just not possible - but we love hearing your suggestions and seeing if we can rise to the challenge!
It is now possible to attach the Viola Bow to the front of the Viola.
The positioning of one of the Viola Bow's charm attachments has been tweaked.
The Woolen Mouse can now sit upon a number of things.
You can now attach charms and gems to the Motor Broom Handlebars.
The Heart Pendant now sits better on necklaces.
The candle holder can now be decorated.

And despite protestations from some of the team, the dolls can how hold things. What could possibly go wrong? Letting little dolls made up of all kinds of weird parts hold blades has always ended in cuddle and unicorns, in my experience.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44616587/6ed3c0000755dfb678f8aea7d1435841fd4d3e98.png"]Don't say we didn't warn you!
The Trinketpedia will now recognise all combined child trinkets attached to a parent trinket when upcycling and selling.
It is no longer possible to prevent time from passing when upcycling. You rascals.

The sack will now register as having been placed successfully on the work mat even if the top flops over the edge. We let goblins live their chosen life, now sacks can too. Even if it is just encouraging them to be lazy and not sitting up straight while the player talks to you. In my day...-
We've adding some additional logging to get to the bottom of a rare situation where Random NPC requests become corrupted. This is presenting in various ways:
Navigation buttons disappear
Getting stuck in the celebration ceremony after chipping
Getting stuck in the Upcycling sequence and trinkets disappearing

If you see any of the following, please open a bug ticket on our Discord and send us your save files and logs straight away. This will help us debug the issue but we can also tweak your files to get you out of this situation!
We had a word with Aimon, and they've agreed to sort something out for players who are coming from EA to 1.0, as they won't be able to keep their progress!
There's now a little system in the game which should make life a lot nicer for players coming to the 1.0 after playing the Early Access version, and a bunch of fixes on top for everyone else.

items.text: As you know, the saves are not compatible - something we'd dearly hoped to avoid, but couldn't - and we do have a guide on how to still play the game with those in an archived branch:
How to access Early Access save files post launch

But for those of you who want to play the 1.0, this new system measures all the things you've bought and unlocked in the game, then converts it to a nice pile of gold that, when you've made your first sale in the game, will be delivered into your coffers!

notes.title: The full details are in this new guide we wrote

items.text: Early Access Gold Transfer
We hope this goes some way to avoid any disappointment!
If you've got Early Access saves as the most recent in Trash Goblin, this is what you'll see:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44616587/57d8dd3c957e23b128e3ec7ed3105f66ac49ef1a.png"]First the game detects your Early Access save...
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44616587/b9c97de6c73d12551aab8420afacb32dc23777da.png"]...and then assuming you want to it tells you how much gold you'll get based on your progress!

"But what if I've already played a bunch in 1.0?" Well, we've covered that in the guide too - I'd recommend having a read, and balance your 1.0 progress against starting a new game with the bonus gold.

It's worth saying we're sorry for any frustrations this has caused, we should really have thought about how to handle this better a lot sooner, but we do listen and react as much - and as fast - as possible. We love you goblins!
But of course this update adds a bunch more stability and bugfixes too! Read on!
Trinket rotation with WASD is now consistent across all shop viewpoints - it was oriented along a world axis before, rather than relevant to your view as a goblin!
Characters are much more... emotional?! We've added tonne of new expression changes for the named NPCs.
SFX are now in place for the stamp on the "Any-Day" Trading Permit.
The map will now close automatically if Aimon starts a conversation with you while you're looking at it.
The district confirmation pop-up now closes properly if you close the map while it is open.
District icons will now always show the quest waiting exclamation mark when there's a quest waiting for you.
The map will also now display sparkle VFX when there's a district quest waiting.
Some Side Quest customers couldn't be dismissed without talking to them a second time, and that's now fixed.
Even more small tweaks and fixes.
The eagle-eyed amongst you will have seen the other patches we put out last week, but just in case you were wondering:
Patch 3: We added some additional logging to help us get the bottom of the issue where some people cannot get Nomia to leave!
Patch 4: All quest completion states are now saved properly on non-English language systems, meaning Nomia will finally stop returning to repeat the same quests over and over!
We've been blown away by the reception of 1.5, Hugh and the DLC - thank you all so much for your support!

As we plan the 1.6 update, we knew we wanted to nip a bunch of nasty bugs in the bud, plus improve some elements that were bothering us ahead of the bigger quality of life update we want to deliver down the line.
1) a fix that prevented progression during the DLC
2) no more lighting woes/dark scenes!
But we've fixed and improved tons of elements of the game across the entire experience so read on for the full details!
We've fixed an issue where the progression of certain Artist of Brimhaven quests were becoming blocked if the Success for Donoval looping quest had not been completed before the DLC was started.

We believe we have fixed an issue in the Artist of Brimhaven content that was causing active quests (such as Jaq's, Esme's and Aunty's) to be removed from the Quest Tracker when multiple quests were summoned at the same time. We removed a time skip call at the end of these non standard quests and replaced it with a quest tracker update call. This should prevent these quests from immediately starting and ending at the same time.
Prevented a potential softlock in the tutorial if you go to bed before selling the bottle to Nomia.
Fix for Expansion Mode button appearing late if you quit the game mid-tutorial.
There's been a small handful of fixes to the Korean, Chinese and Hungarian localisations.
The Hungarian credits now roll properly.
The opening story beat for the Artist of Brimhaven DLC is now fully visible in Thai.
Aimon now specifically asks for the Fishy Trophy to be both Silver and Upcycled in the German and Chinese localisation.
Some of Sam and Oli's dialogue had become muddled so we've corrected that.
We've nuked a few more typos which were particularly embarrassing to our Producer as she was the one that introduced them!
The Clawed Gem and Silver Ring now have the correct names in Hungarian.
We've addressed the trinket highlight outline. It used to look pretty ugly on smaller trinkets!
Some renovation quest mercy timer trinkets have been changed to more relevant trinkets.
The colours of trinkets attached to Corks or certain Lids will no longer automatically extract when entering Recolouring Mode.
Fixed an issue where some trinkets became unticked in the Quest Tracker, despite being valid.
Fix for the Quest Tracker counting one trinket multiple times.
There is now clearer messaging around the unlock moment for Hugh for players on existing saves.
The camera's "zoom into NPCs" movement at market districts has been changed back to its previous settings so you can see more of the background art.
The Game Guide now has a section for Recolouring (we've removed Tips for now).
The best kept secret bug in the game has now been fixed; you can no longer purchase customisation presets if you have no gold!
We've fixed an issue that prevented NPCs from emoting when there was more than one on screen, and we've gone back through the game adding expression changes to these moments.
Tooltips will no longer overflow the game window when playing on fullscreen.
We've changed the position of the zoom buttons for the Brimhaven district.
We've added the animations to Hugh that we didn't have time to complete before the 1.5 launch.
We've new lighting and postprocessing to the Brimhaven district so it can be appreciated in all its restored beauty.
We've removed the lighting system that was switching off shop lights and not turning them back on under certain circumstances.

Nomia's sprite had been inexplicably shrunk to half of the usual NPC size so they were appearing fuzzy. They've now been restored to their full mustachioed glory. Aimon's sprite was fine though, so that's more "proof" of a certain theory.

We have addressed an issue that was causing achievements to make too many calls to the server and then stop firing, resulting in achievements not triggering correctly for Epic Game Store customers. This also results in a smidge better performance on all platforms.
Lighting in the shop has been improved and optimised.
Removed a misplaced sparkle vfx in chipping and cleaning ceremonies.
Fixed an issue where players could make their tools disappear during associated play (eg: chisel during chipping).
FIX
Choosing both options during the first Redoir conversation now successfully gives you the Upcycler tool.

releases.displayName: "Stock N Trade" update out now - huge new features, gameplay & content!

items.text: It's the final update before 1.0 launch! Oh my gosh! Time has flown, and the team is so excited to get this latest update into your mitts - partly because we think it's more packed with goodies than a Grandma Egg, but also so we can concentrate fully on the launch. We're selfish/dedicated that way! Of course that means you should look out for a release date announcement before long, but until then we've got lots of other exciting things to share with you, plus a lovely breakdown of the features and content in Stock N Trade!
Here's the update trailer!
Sale & Upcoming Price Changes

Related to that, we're going to increase the price ahead of our 1.0 launch to $19.99 (up from its current price of $14.99). At the moment we're planning for that price increase to happen on the 21st May. Trash Goblin has increased in quality, content, and value for money steadily since we launched in Early Access 6 months ago, and we also "priced" it at this value for the Kickstarter rewards way back in 2023. We have thought long and hard about this, and we believe it's a fair price - and of course we hope you do too! We can see a lot of players already logging 20hrs+ (and some over 50hrs or 100hrs) in the Early Access version, and there's a ton of content coming in today's update as well as the 1.0 so we're keeping our fingers crossed that it seems like a reasonable change. Let us know what you think!
To summarise, it's the cheapest right now that it will be for a long time, so make the most of it!
Beta!

We mentioned a Beta last time, and now we've got dates for you! The Beta will be run from the 2nd to the 5th May. It will be focused on the Story, specifically Acts 1 & 2. Beta Goblins will be automatically involved, but we want more people to come and help us figure out if we've done Donoval justice* so we're running a 1st-come 1st-served system on our discord. Between now and then just head over to the beta channel and respond to the instructions there! Please do bear in mind that this is not a shortcut to progress in the launch game - see below for details but sadly saves will not be migrating from Early Access to 1.0.
*Donoval's story may or may not wrap up in the Beta content, I just know he's the fave right now, sorry for being a tease!
Chill Hoarding Bundle!

We've got another bundle going, this time with the chillest game I've ever seen, Koi Farm! In Koi Farm you crossbreed Koi in serene ponds, then catalogue & share the endless varieties you discover. It was suggested by our lovely community as a great pairing so we're excited to launch that today as well! If you own Trash Goblin you'll get a little extra off of Koi Farm, and vice versa! Check it out here!
London Games Festival

We're also delighted to be featured as part of the London Games Festival! It's a Steam event as well as a physical festival held here in the UK's capital, and we had Trash Goblin on a stand at the New Game Plus event last week as part of the "Official Selection", while this Friday we're going to be showing the game to the public as part of a live event in Trafalgar Square! The one with all the statues! It's so cool!
"Enough blethering, what's in the blinkin' update?!"
A fair if slightly rudely posed question.
Display Mat

We heard you when you said you wanted to feel more like a shopkeeper, setting up things on shelves for people to buy. Having customers pick your favourite items and the things you've worked the hardest on. Or, you know, slinging all your spare crap somewhere and insisting that your patrons buy it before anything else. Well, now you can! You buy and upgrade the Display Mat via the Expansion Mode, and once it's there you can place your favourite creations on it, which will attract customers passing by, and they'll be very keen to pay over the odds for whatever you've placed in view! Top tip; objects are physical so you can squeeze as many trinkets onto the mat as you like...
Lizard paper dolls

Donoval. Ah, Donoval. What will become of your quest for warmth? What beauty do you see in the humble bedpan? And do all Lizardfolk desire these same humble containers with the same fervour as you? Well, now that we've added them to the random customer pool, we can all find out together!
Trinket attributes/customer requests
It's been a long time coming, but we've completely overhauled how customers and trinkets work. Trinkets now have attributes, and Customers now make a wider and more interesting variety of requests:
They might ask specifically for a clean version of a trinket
They may want an upcycled trinket, with that little something extra
They can also ask for a ""type"" of trinket - a Lid, Jewellery, that sort of thing - allowing you to pick and choose which trinket to sell to fulfill their needs
And they might have something really specific in mind, but if you can't be bothered you can always just dismiss them!
Trinket request highlighting

Another longer-requested feature, you can now find the exact trinket you're after at the press of a button. All you need to do is click on the magnifying glass icon next to the trinket listed in the quest tracker, and it will be highlighted in your stash and in the workshop. It lasts for a few seconds, so you might need to click on it again if you struggle.
Fifteen new trinkets
It was about time we threw some more intriguing, rare, trashy and weird trinkets into the Chasm ready for you to unearth.
Menacing Charm
Menacing Charm Broach
Throwing Knife Blade
Throwing Knife Hilt
Throwing Knife Pommel
Drill Attachment
Fork Attachment
Rake Attachment
Human Sword Blade
Human Sword Hilt
Human Sword Pommel
Terrarium
Succulent
Sunburst Gem
Bead Necklace Charm
Tool Belt

We know how much ya'll hated putting down your tools - finding the right spot for them, and then maybe losing track of them as well. Us too. So we've added a Tool Belt to the game, meaning you no longer have to fiddle around finding space for your tools. They just sit there patiently waiting, ready to pop on and off as you need them. Picking tools up and putting tools down hasn't changed functionally - you still press the same buttons, it's just now they have their special place. For now, the art for the tools is the basic ones, and we'll no doubt make that reflect all the upgrades before long.
New Cosmetics
We didn't give you any new cosmetics to play with last update, and we felt slightly bad about it so we went nuts on this one!
Stock N Trade themed set, which includes wallpaper, mats and bedclothes, all themed around our favourite trinket, the Grandma Egg!
Ambassador themes set, in honour of one of our Goblin Ambassadors, Andromeda Galaxi!
Coloured set. So many colours! We've gone mad, now you can completely rainbow your workshop, and even change the colour of your shelves!
Improved handling/dragging

We've overhauled the handling of items in the game - we've worked really hard to improve all the dragging, the placement, the picking up and rotating things - every single one of those little interactions now feel way smoother and more reliable than before, and basically hits the vision we had at the very start of this game for how tactile and responsive we wanted it to be!
3D Trinket Rotation

Part of the rework above led us to decide to allow you to rotate a held trinket in all 3 axis of movement, meaning you can essentially position them in any pose you could possibly want! This opens up so much potential for customising your shop and you can do so by simply using the WASD keys while holding any trinket in the game. This means that navigation of the views is now limited to the arrow cursor keys. The only caveat on this new rotation gameplay is that when you pick a trinket back up again, it will re-orient to its normal pose, but that's something we want to work on. We'd love to see pictures!
New Sales Receipt

Because of all the additional elements that go into serving a trinket to a customer, we've reworked the sales receipt, meaning you can now see the status of the trinket and any attachments, plus of course if there was any impact of being on the Display Mat!

The credits have been updated with additional names from our Kickstarter backers – please remember to go fill out your survey responses, it only takes 5 minutes and then we can include your name in the next update.
Navigation of views is no longer possible with the A and S keys, but still works a-ok with the arrow cursor keys, and the buttons on the UI.
Updated 4 shelf positions, lowering them for ease of placement, so do check if you have any floating trinkets!

We've brought the 'bad placement' visual back. We are not sure where it went. It displays when you are holding a trinket over a location that is either occupied, or would result in the item dropping to the floor. In the former case, you can drop it if you want (piles of trinkets!). In the latter case, you cannot place the item. Functionally, this has been in the game for a long time, but this makes it a lot clearer.
Weather effects will no longer be seen passing through the inside of the red panda's mouth!
Trinkets icons will no longer appear as white boxes in the Stash after they've been placed in the Soak Tub or Pay-What-You-Can box.
We've fixed a bunch of typos and grammatical errors in Mycelle's dialogue - thanks to our lovely community for pointing them out!
Soak Tub-related SFX are now muted when the SFX slider is set to 0.
The Wizards hat is now upright by default when removed from the Stash.
The large workmat upgrade description no longer describes itself as "colourful". Because it is not, it is plain. The poor thing couldn't be more vanilla if it tried.

The 1.0! We're excited to add tons of gameplay and content to this, we've been saving it up over the course of development and of course have always planned for multiple new features to arrive at launch so it makes the whole game feel fresh and new. For the full details hit up the post we wrote recently about the roadmap which you can find here, but the headline features we're adding for 1.0 are as follows:
District Travel
10hrs+ of Story
Trinket request system
City Map & calendar
Trinketpedia
Delver License System
Dismissal and Summoning of Named Customers
More Cosmetic Options
Achievements
Cost, Price and Randomness Rebalance
Tons of new trinkets
A Chunk (but not all) of the Kickstarter Rewards
Founders Pack
Save Incompatibility
"We detailed this in our last post too, but it's important enough to restate here.

It is something we'd hoped to avoid, but sadly cannot. The tl;dr is that game saves from before the 1.0 won't be compatible with the 1.0, but we'll arrange access to a special branch on Steam that keeps this legacy ""0.9"" version live for anyone who wants it, for free.

There are many factors at play, some that are worth talking about a bit. First up, the story structure behind the scenes means that we're going to have to rework and replace the story elements from the EA version, and the code/writing work to make both 'versions' of the first 4 hours or so compatible are just not feasible. Planning it, doing it, then testing it - it's a can of worms for weird bugs and endless frustration for players. But of course what about all your progress?!

The plan is that the penultimate build (the one before 1.0) will go onto a dedicated branch on Steam, and that will be accessible via a password, and will not cost anything to access. We will give out the password and make it accessible to the Early Access community on launch day.

On that day, anyone with existing save files who wants to continue playing can hop over onto that branch and continue to their heart's desire, but there will be nothing new for you - it'll feature bug fixes etc, but most likely just endless random customers.

Meanwhile on the 1.0 main branch, when people boot the launch version for the first time people will see there's no ""Continue"" button on the title screen, just ""New Game"". We will keep talking about this of course, and do as much as we can to prevent someone losing a save from the previous version that they wanted to keep. More details on that will be coming closer to the time. This will also of course be updated across all our FAQs and various channels of communication."

And that's it - another bumper update with tons of new features and loads of exciting news to share! Keep an eye out for news on the launch date, and start getting hyped for it! In the meantime join our discord for more fun and Trash Goblin updates!
Goblins, we come bearing gifts!

The holiday season is upon and what better way to celebrate than jumping into Trash Goblin's Festive update and decorating your workshop! That's right, we've added cosmetic sets to the game so you can get your cosy workshop ready for the festive season. And that's not all, read on to learn all about the new features included in this patch.
Cosmetic Customisation

You are now able to decorate your shop! Customisation mode allows you to purchase and apply different wallpapers, bedding and work mats. You can even change the look of the your shelves. Purchase cosmetic sets to unlock new options, and mix-n-match to your heart's content! Plus, you can save presets for easy swapping between looks! Customisation mode is introduced with two themed sets (plus of course the ability to go back to the default 'scruffy workshop' visuals):
Festive Cosmetic Set
A full set of Festive themed cosmetics. Winter Festival has come to Silver City, so what better way to celebrate than with colourful wallpaper, shelves, and decorations!
Wintry Nights Cosmetic Set
A lovely second set of cosmetics based around wintry nights, frosty stars and the night sky.
Weather
It would hardly be the Festive update without some snow, so we've added a snowy backdrop for the season and you'll now see snow in the mix of weather too.
Soak Tub
A much-requested new way to clean things - buy the soak tub and you'll be able to plop any dirty trinket inside. Leave it overnight and in the morning you'll find it perfectly cleaned!
Brand New Character & Quest

Mycelle the mushroom has surfaced! This lil' mushroom is a self-started tour guide in the safer parts of the Chasm, and you'll be helping them out with their entrepreneurial aspirations! Plus Donoval and Hullifer also return with a new quest each.
10 New Trinkets
🎶 5 gold rings🎶: Dwarven Ring, Wrap Ring, Bone Ring, Simple Ring and Filigree Ring
Three beautiful gems to attach to rings (and other trinkets): the round, teardrop and insect gems
A hook!
And a miniature Wizard Hat!
Tutorial Rework
We've simplified the tutorial to make it more streamlined and addressed a number of related bugs.
The Continue and New Game buttons have been switched around on the title screen
We've added an overlay so it is clearer when you're in expansion and customisation modes

The credits have been implemented and are accessible from the title screen (if you're a Kickstarter backer, have fun spotting your name. If you don't see your name then please make sure you go fill out your survey ;) )
For those who didn't think the broken lamp gelled with a cosy vibe, you can now upgrade it to a fully repaired lamp
The Viola Tuning Peg can finally be attached to the Viola!

This is the 3rd step in our road towards our 1.0 launch next year! We'll be keeping our eye on how this update – and the Full of Beans update – both went down. We want to catch any nasty bugs of course, but also we want to know if or how we should change our plans for 2025! We've updated the Roadmap too - yet another significant update shipped to you lovely goblins! Plus we're now sat at 97% positive in the past 30 days, something we're just incredibly humbled by. In the meantime please do pop by our Discord and chat to us about the update, and if you haven't already leaving a review really does help us out so much!
Hello Goblins and welcome to our first Early Access content update: Full of Beans!

Seems you've been very busy little goblins! We've had many reports of the woes of having too many trinkets and not enough ways to get rid of them, so the Full of Beans update brings you new ways to manage your stock. You now have the ability to expand the space in your Stash book, and we're also introducing the Pay-What-You-Can Box. Read on to learn more about them, plus all the additional new features and fixes included in this patch!
Stash Upgrades

This much-requested feature is in! Upgrade your stash to hold loads more trinkets! Purchase and then upgrade the Chest to increase your stash slots, and find a few bonus slots through other upgrades scattered around the shop too! If you already own certain upgrades, such as larger workbenches, you'll find some extra stash slots already unlocked the next time you load your save file.
Pay-What-You-Can Box

Purchase this to help clear out unwanted stock! Drop trinkets into the box, then leave them overnight. Passing customers might well help themselves, and will probably – though not always – leave you some gold! You can upgrade the box with more item slots, but be aware that unless someone's feeling really generous, most of the time you'll only get a pittance for the trinket.
Stove & Coffee Pot

Purchase this set to unlock a nice hot brew every day! Drinking coffee (for a small cost) gives you 1 bonus timeslot to use every day, which means you can get more done! But only once. Goblins don't over-caffeinate. And even without the coffee, the stove adds a lovely cosy ambience to the shop, ready for the cold months ahead.
Brand new character & quest

Raniel has recently arrived in the city, and this kindly Frog's mother is a little worried about him. Like any good frogkin, he's going to make sure to assuage her concerns - and he's about to meet you, so he'll be fine! Plus we've also added one new quest each for Ortici and Virgil.
10 new trinkets
These will appear via sacks as per normal, with their own cruft chipping 'puzzle' to clear.
A Bead Necklace
An Orcish Dagger which is made up of the Blade, Hilt and Pommel
The Viola and of course the Bow you'd need to play it
A Wooden Mask, plus its Ear and Horn to complete the look
An accessory for the Lich Crown
Every single trinket now has their own individual icon making it easier to tell exactly what they are in the Stash book.
Redoir's VO has been updated.
You can now dismiss all NPCs, not just the 'random' ones.
We've done a huge optimisation pass on the game (focusing mostly on UI & textures) to help the game run smoother on low end machines.

We've standardised the various shelf sizes to make it easy for them to be updated in future (more on that down the line). You shouldn't notice a difference but do let us know if you spot any oddities.
We've addressed an issue which prevented trinkets being placed on the edge of the largest workbench upgrade after reloading save files.
We have significantly reduced the memory footprint of our NPCs shaders and textures which we are hoping will prevent most of the crashes that some of you have been experiencing.
The trinket counter in the top right of the UI has been removed to prevent confusion while we think about how to fix and revamp it.
We fixed an issue that was causing the hands of human customers to appear transparent.
The Lute will no longer clip through the sales mat when placed on the customer desk.
Coin bags will no longer drop to the floor when trying to add them to the Stash book if it's completely full of trinkets.
We've fixed another instance of duplicated trinkets appearing in the sack after clicking on random stranger NPCs multiple times.
The upcycling connection point for the Bent Nail Handle is now on the head of the nail rather than on its point.
Customers are now actually grateful for your hard work and will smile at you when you provide them with their requested trinkets!
Various other tweaks and minor fixes.

Of course this is just the first step in a long and winding road towards our 1.0 launch next year! Sometime in December, and certainly before Christmas, we'll be dropping the "Festive" content update for you lucky lot! In the meantime we'll be keeping our eye on how Full of Beans went down. Not only so we can fix any nasty bugs ya'll find, but also to see if we can steer or adapt our plans for the coming months! Speaking of which, check out the new Roadmap - it feels so good to be chugging along! Not only that, but so far the response from you has been amazing. Seeing our review score go steadily up in the last 3 weeks since launch has been super motivating for us all. So until next time, please do pop by our Discord and chat to us about the update, and if you haven't already leaving a review really does help us out so much!

items.text: Save files will no longer corrupt when quitting via Alt+F4 (or if experiencing a crash) immediately after loading into the game. In other words, no more missing trinkets when reloading saves.

In other news, we’re part of Secret Mode’s Cozy Quest event which runs up to the 18th of November. Trash Goblin is discounted alongside an amazing bunch of cute and cosy games, so if you’re in need of a comforting, wholesome weekend then make sure you check it out.
Hello Goblins and welcome to Hotfix 3!

Once again, thank you so much for all your support, reviews and especially for your help with hunting down these pesky bugs. And thank you for your patience while we addressed this latest batch of fixes for you.
Tooltips will now appear over trinkets when hovering over them for two seconds, including outside the stash.
Trinkets will no longer vanish after returning to the main menu half way through cleaning them.
We've added a button to reset tools on the workbench in case they get lost on messy desks!
We fixed an issue that caused some trinkets to go missing when reloading save files.
You will no longer get stuck in an endless loop with a customer repeating their request if you cancel the deal at the last minute.
We've made some tweaks to make saving more robust and prevent save file corruption when reloading a save game after cleaning.
We've made various stability fixes to address some crashes.
The stash will now automatically open when you begin upcycling.
Non-compatible trinkets on the workbench and shelves are now greyed out when upcycling, similar to the way they are in the stash.
When upcycling you are no longer forced to place held trinkets in the stash, they can now be placed on the workbench or on shelves.
Upcycler upgrades will now unlock even when reloading a save file at the start of the tool upgrade quest.
Reloading a save at the start of the shop upgrade quest will no longer cause it to auto complete and bypass the unlocking of the expansion mode button.
You can no longer place trinkets behind the tapestries at the back of the shopkeeper area.
There is no longer a delay preventing you from progressing through dialogue once it has finished typing to the dialogue box.
A 'continue' icon will now appear on dialogue boxes to indicate when the dialogue has finished printing and can be progressed.
You no longer have to click an NPC twice to re-initiate a conversation after selecting 'no deal'.
We've implemented a new mouse-over effect on NPCs and standardised it.
Some minor tweaks have been made to refine the flow of the tutorial.
Mushromeo's quest has been tweaked to prevent possible confusion over their amorous trinket requests.
Redoir’s trigger box no longer fills the entire customer window and instead matches her character model rather than her personality.
A bunch of NPCs have been re-scaled relative to one another. No more giant, intimidating amphibians!
Plus a small handful of miscellaneous tweaks and minor fixes.

We're still working on an issue which prevents trinkets being placed on the edge of the largest workbench upgrade after reloading save files. We're nearly there but it's a system that touches a lot of things and it's a bit like opening a can of worms! We need more time to make sure it's working fully before we release it into the wild, and we'll get this out in another patch ASAP.
As a refresher, here are links to our previous patch notes for Hotfix 2 and Hotfix 1.
If you haven’t already done so, then remember to check out our Early Access roadmap for an insight into our update schedule.
And finally, details of how to report any other bugs you encounter can now be found in our brand new Troubleshooting Guide (along with info on where to find save files and player logs).
Say hi to our third patch, just a few days over a week since launch! We're loving seeing all the mad creations and hilarious stories coming from your time in Silver City!
As well as a large batch of bug fixes, this update introduces a new NPC as well as a brand new plushie trinket: Mister Pickles and his Witch Doll!
We wanted to include Mister Pickles in the launch build last week, but you know what cats are like; they'll arrive in their own sweet time! So here he finally is.

Also we've been listening to all the feedback we've received, and have fixed what we think are some of the biggest issues that we were seeing reported - specifically players getting stuck with no customers or seeing items disappear - thankfully neither of which was not affecting too many people.

We're also aware that some people coming from Early Access are disappointed by the lack of carry over with the saves. We've got a guide for you here, and are keen to do what we can to ameliorate the problem.

On that note, if there's anything going wrong, the first port of call should be our discord - we're often able to fix issues with save games to step around problems for people, although sadly at the moment, that does not include carrying over progress from the EA version.
With all that said, here's what we've managed to fix! Enjoy!
We've made some changes that should stop Nomia from refusing to leave the customer window after you've dismissed them.
The game no longer autosaves just the contents of your Stash when loading a save file, so immediately hard quitting will no longer result in the loss of all trinkets in your workshop!
We've changed the Quest Tracker icon for summoning NPCs from a bell to an envelope to avoid confusion with the bell on the customer desk.

We've implemented a fix to prevent you clicking through conversations too quickly and missing the dialogue. You can still spam through, it just was sometimes skipping a full panel entirely which was not ideal for anyone.

Rebooting the game no longer advances the quest wait timer by the number of time slots already played on a save, thus triggering all the side quests to start firing at once! If you were feeling like you'd have a really long run of customers just one after another, this will have them arriving at the intended and much more chill pace.
You can no longer select trinkets on shelves behind the open Stash book when upcycling. Which is great, cos it was really easy to accidentally pick something up and get confused.
Picking up trinkets before the upcycling connection animation has completed will no longer result in a missing connection line between trinket and socket.
We've tweaked Akilah's quest to make it clear that he wants \four\ trinkets attached to his Wooden Mask.
We've added in a handful of new expression changes for the named NPCs - more to come in a future update!
Sound effects for the Delver Licence stamp, toggling pages in the Stash book and dismissing customers are now in.
The armoire now creaks!
The correct text babble now plays for each NPC when there's more than one character on screen at the same time.
There are now new audio sliders to allow you to turn off the NPC voiceover and also the sound of the shop bell.
Collette's hitbox is no longer misaligned.
Dialogue response boxes will no longer shift about on screen. Nobody mentioned this really, but it was bugging the crap out of the dev team.
The Confirm and Cancel options on Expansion Mode panels now scale with font size and should be at least partially visible underneath the Quest Tracker when expanded.
We've fixed an issue where trinkets could trigger the Stash book's drop animation into an endless loop that locked up the game.
The Black Flame Candles are now, well, black!
The continue indicator arrow on dialogue panels will no longer become misaligned.
You can no longer see the Sorcerer's Focus Gem through its puzzle blocks.
We've adjusted the dirt on the Melty Teacup Handle and the Carved Whistle to make them a tad easier to clean with the level 1 sponge, as some people were getting stuck on 99%.
Nimble Jack no longer has an elongated neck when he is upcycled (if your existing Nimble Jack still has a stretched neck, then you'll need to remove and reattach his head in order to see the change).
The Lute was too large and powerful, so we've shrunk it to make it easier to handle - remember to rotate trinkets with WASD if you're having trouble placing them on the sales mat.
We've increased the size of the Calligraphy Pen Nib so it is much easier to see and pick up.
It's no longer possible to connect a compass, or a bottle, or some other weird things through the centre of the Artisanal Hand.
The Seer's Rabbit Skull and Bone Ring will no longer change orientation once the upcycling ceremony is complete.
Fixed some typos in the Game Guide and one in Jaq's dialogue.
Also we've talked about unveiling the roadmap soon, and while we're not quite as far along with that as we'd like, we do have something here to show you we mean business!

Hello and welcome to the first Trash Goblin Hotfix!
We've focused on some showstoppers and saving/loading work as these are the areas you have been reporting on the most!
If you update the game it should now be at version 0.1.4351
Here are the things we managed to fix today!
The game has always autosaved, but we weren't telling you when! 😅

stash change
when you quit to the main menu

items.text: So much has been going on with the game recently, and it's on the cusp of being presentable, but I thought why not give you a look at the state of things literally right now. As in, I wrote this sentence, went away and grabbed a screenshot, then came back here to paste it in and write the rest of this post.
If you've played the demo or seen screenshots you might be thinking... where'd it all go?!
So what, indeed, has changed? Some big things, and some smaller. Rather than force you to guess (though that would be fun) how about I list it all*?!
*except I might forget some and/or leave some out on purpose 😅
No More Cruft
That's right, you ain't cleaning that up, and the HUD ain't counting it either! Basically this was a vestigial feature that had no purpose (yet). And people kept asking. So out it comes!
Decorations-be-where?

Yes indeed. It's rather sparse there, isn't it? We're in the middle of building and testing the expansion gameplay! So yeah, at the start of the game, it might feel a little emptier than you're used to from the demo, but you'll be able to buy all kinds of things to decorate with!
Stash Book In Your Face!

We've moved the stash book to the HUD, essentially linking it to the camera so it's always with you (and right now so are the comically large VFX that moved with it). Makes things easier, and simpler, and declutters the workspace too!
Strange Button, I See You. Explain Yourself.

Off to the right-hand side of the Personal Space navigation button is a little price-tag-looking fella. This unassuming fellow is what gets you into Expansion Mode! Oh boy, what fun you'll be having there.

I'll leave it there - with one or two more changes for ya'll to spot and discuss. Rest assured we are super excited about all of this getting into your hands, and if you're on the right backer tier, we're dearly hoping to get another Beta going in the coming weeks. There's a lot more than just UI and assets being moved around, lemme tell you!
Meanwhile, in the ramp-up to the huge news coming next week - yes, that's right, I said HUGE - I think you might wanna get all up in our discord if you've not bothered yet.

Till next time, stay Goblin, and keep those floppy ears out for the rumbling of that news I've teased about fifteen million times by now, does it even count as a tease or is it just annoying at this point...

Welcome Goblins, to another development update! I hope you've all been enjoying August, as it's nearly over (my, how time flies) and as I type that I realise how close we are to the game's Early Access launch!

I'm still not going to announce that just yet, but blimey if we aren't beginning to really feel the pressure. We've got an amazing team and every confidence we'll be delivering this game soon, to a really high standard... as you know Early Access launch is just the beginning so we're also planning the update roadmap and that's all really exciting too.
Anyway, what choice cuts of development am I going to share this time? Read on!

We keep talking about letting you play for as long as you like, even at EA launch. And with that comes a challenge - what will you want to spend all your hard-earned Gold on? Well, we've spent a lot of time figuring that out, and we want to show you a little glimpse that tells a lot.
This is a mockup, the real button will be Well Nice.

The extra button there is to move into Shop Expansion Mode, where we let you tinkering goblins purchase expansions and cosmetics across all areas of the game. We obviously want you to be able to upgrade your Tools. We think it'd be ace for you to customise your workspace in some meaningful ways. And we also want to let you spend on, for want of a better word, buffs or modifiers that make your days as a Trash Goblin more fun, all while locking into the vibes of the game and the world we're building.

We're still discussing and feeling out which ones we want to launch with, but it's safe to say they'll feature in these updates as and when we get them into a shareable state. I want to tease, but not over-promise!
One thing we're completely confident of is the initial cast of characters you'll meet in the Early Access launch version!
Left to Right we've got Geronimus, Redoir, Aimon, Nomia and a new mystery character!

No prizes for spotting there's one more who we'll unveil properly at some point soon, but currently we call them "Delver Goblin - Aunty X". The X makes them sound a bit sinister, but trust me when I say that the only person who needs to be nervous around this character is Aimon. I'll say no more!

This means the current plan is that Donoval & Jaq won't feature in the launch version, but of course, this is the "minimal" plan and as soon as we know how much time we can devote to more quests, they'll be top of the list to be added back in! We just want all the named characters to have really awesome stories for you to enjoy with them, so until we're confident we're hitting our quality standards, we won't promise anything more.

We didn't realise Diablo runs an event that celebrates makes players be mean towards goblins every year?! Well, we told our little fellow about it and despite our warnings he couldn't resist the opportunity to meet some new customers, and maybe even turn them into friends?!
Our lil' goblin is just so excited to share his trinkets with other goblins, regardless of the dangers involved!
We're not so sure it was totally safe to be there, but I don't think anyone could confuse our Goblin for any other type. Besides, it was a flying visit and we're told nobody got hurt.

Oh boy, I wonder how many of you spotted this in the build version of that screenshot? We've been shouting about it a bit and will be more, but Trash Goblin is going to be at SXSW Sydney! Sadly the team can't make the trip but we're super excited about people playing our game all the way around the world, so if you're there in Sydney, please do tell us - maybe even take a selfie with the game and share it with us!
If you haven't, please do go and "Follow" Trash Goblin on Steam, it'll help us reach you with even more great goblin content and updates, especially once the game's out!

See that highlighted button? It sits right next to the Wishlist button - which you've already all clicked of course because you're the greatest goblins in the world - and this is what it looks like when you've been lovely and Follow-ed the game too 🥰
...that's daft-and-tired-writer-speak for "bye for now". Yup, that's it for this update, so until next time make sure your favourite goblins don't go near Diablo IV ⚔️
